# Documentation templates

Use these templates as starting points for new pages:

- [Guide template](GUIDE.md) — task-oriented procedures for users, contributors, or maintainers.
- [Reference template](REFERENCE.md) — source-backed technical facts and language/API declarations.

Before publishing a page:

1. Copy the relevant template to its canonical location.
2. Replace all bracketed prompts and authoring comments.
3. Remove sections that do not apply.
4. Identify the audience, status, and scope.
5. Check relative links and GitHub rendering.
6. Verify every command and every GFA BASIC claim against the stated environment or source.
7. Review copyright and redistribution constraints.

Templates do not establish that a feature is implemented or supported. Follow the [documentation policy](../DOCUMENTATION.md).
